acceptance: The first-CI failure rate and the share of PRs with a failed CI run for the four weeks are reported against the baseline, with the method.
If the target is missed, the main failure categories are named and follow-up items filed.
description: #4025 (6d2c431, merged 2026-11-07) made `make pr-open` require a preflight receipt bound to the pushed tree. Baseline (2026-10-28 to 11-07): 47 of 286 first CI runs failed (16.4%), and 35% of PRs had a failed CI run. The target is a first-CI failure rate of 10% or less. Measure 2026-11-08 to 2026-12-05 the same way, and review whether `.github/preflight-known-failures.json` has grown.
